name: Chocolate digestives
steps: Take two out and reseal the packet; that is a normal portion with a cup of tea.
Store chocolate side up in a cool cupboard so they do not stick together in warm weather.

name: Dark chocolate squares
steps: Snap off two squares and fold the wrapper back over the rest of the bar.
Dark chocolate is strong enough that a couple of squares with a coffee usually does the job; check the label if you need it dairy free.

name: Ice cream
steps: Let the tub soften for a couple of minutes, then take one rounded scoop into a small bowl and put the tub straight back in the freezer.
A few berries or a sliced banana over the top makes one scoop feel like a proper pudding.

name: Jaffa cakes
steps: Three from the sleeve is a sensible portion; put the box away before you sit down with them.
They are light and low in fat for a biscuit, which is why the box empties so fast.

name: Mini chocolate bar

ingredients.display: 1 fun-size or mini milk chocolate bar (25 g)

steps: Have one small bar rather than breaking into a full-size one, which is nearer 45 g.
Buying the multipack of minis rather than sharing bars makes the portion decide itself.
